logline: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.

moments.description: Juliana trudges through a muddy, rain-soaked forest in her white wedding gown while holding her shivering cloak.
The Mysterious Bearded Man expresses regret to Juliana about the harsh journey, and she quietly admits the bitter reality of her situation.
moments.key_dialogue: I know this is not the life you came from.

moments.description: Juliana arrives at a tiny, rustic stone cottage in the middle of the dark woods and reacts with stunned disbelief.
moments.key_dialogue: At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me.

moments.description: Juliana vigorously scrubs the wooden table to keep her mind off everything she lost, while the Mysterious Bearded Man silently kneels to help.
moments.key_dialogue: If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost.

moments.description: As the warm hearth fire crackles between them, Juliana reflects in voiceover on losing her family and finding unexpected safety beside her new husband.
moments.key_dialogue: Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid.
